_note: What you see: Lore article with a scheduled reveal for players, a block for game masters only, the list of lore pages including the rulebook and a map of the world with pins.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Lore-artikel met geplande onthulling voor spelers, een blok alleen voor spelleiders, de lijst lorepagina's inclusief regelboek en een kaart van de wereld met pinnen.
wereld De Zuiderlanden · geschreven door: world De Zuiderlanden · written by Lars de Koning
Spelers zien deze pagina vanaf vr 13 jun: Players see this page from vr 13 juni 2026 09.00, the morning of the Zomertreffen. Until then only game masters see it.
In de winter van het jaar 412 brak de di: In the winter of the year 412 the dyke at Wilgenrode broke. The water of the Drecht ran over the fields for three days and the estate of the Van de Wilgen family was flooded. Those who could fled to the hills near Zuiddrecht-haven.
De Raad van Zuiddrecht weigerde de vluch: The Raad van Zuiddrecht refused to let the refugees inside the walls. The Gilde van de Wilgen arose that winter, when healers and smiths together set up a camp at the edge of the Nevelwoud. Since then the guild and the council distrust each other.
Op het landgoed staan nog de resten van: The remains of the old chapel still stand on the estate. Players who walk around there find the willow leaf that is also on the Silver amulet.
De dijk brak niet vanzelf. Raadslid Thor: The dyke did not break by itself. Council member Thorvald de Grijze had it breached to buy the family's land cheaply. The proof lies in the council archive. Players do not see this block, not even after the reveal.
Kaart van De Zuiderlanden met pinnen bij: Map of De Zuiderlanden with pins at Wilgenrode, Zuiddrecht-haven and Nevelwoud
Kaartbestand kaart-zuiderlanden.png uit: Map file kaart-zuiderlanden.png from Nextcloud Files. Players see the map and the pins that belong to shared pages.
